real_defects.issue: parseTrades took line 1 as the header, so an export with a title or account line above the header (Schwab's older 'Transactions for account ... as of ...' line, a 'For Account:' block) was refused whole with 'Need columns for: date, symbol, action (buy/sell), quantity.' Fixed: the first of the first 10 non-blank lines that names every required column is the header; tests in calc.test.mjs.

Row numbers were counted after blank lines were dropped, so errors and sale lines pointed at the wrong row in any file with blank lines (Fidelity's export ends with a blank line and a disclaimer: the disclaimer at line 7 was reported as 'Line 4'). Fixed: each row keeps its own line number in the file.

parseCsv dropped blank rows and normalizeSales/normalizeStock numbered skipped rows i + 2, so a blank line or a quoted note with a line break made a skipped row's line point at the wrong file line. Fixed: parseCsv tags each row with the file line it starts on.
parseCsv numbered rows n + 2 after dropping blank lines, so 'Line N: wage level must be ...' pointed at the wrong row. Fixed: rows keep their file line.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
